Subject: Quick recap + propose technical deep dive (60–90m)

Hi Paul —

Great to meet earlier — appreciate the context on Nebula's latency targets and current model mix. Quick recap from our side:
- Goal: validate performance and cost profile for your real-time scoring pipeline (p95 latency target <150ms).
- Workloads discussed: concurrent user sessions (burst to 400qps), short-chat + long (>1k token) summarization paths, and embeddings for semantic search.
- Primary concerns: KV cache warmup time, autoscale behavior during sustained bursts, and PII handling in private deployments.

Next step: we'd like to schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML infra and serving leads to walk through: architecture fit, data flow, sample payloads, and a live perf/compatibility checklist. Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-06-09 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-06-10 09:00–10:30
- Thu 2026-06-11 13:00–14:30

Can you confirm which of those work for you + anyone else from Nebula who should join? I attached a mutual action plan and a draft agenda so the team can prep.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

—Camila
